scope: Packaged bin/upgrade.bl through real durable job, actual issuer, strict SSH, NixOS restricted gateway, host journal, control authentication, persistent controller and nginx public route. Trusted fixture seeds consumed review records; no test job/host/probe invoker.
limitations: Trusted consumed-review fixture does not qualify human approval UI or initial source planning/release transfer
Workstation root CLI adoption and production host rollout remain separate
No production database migrated and no native Messages ingress cutover
No cross-runtime writer handover, reboot continuity or full HTTP/WebSocket traffic qualification in this gate
Single-run startup measurements; not a performance benchmark; CLI library closure is source-loaded
